text: The C-4 guard is duplicated: resolve.go:133 sets Coverage=Unverified on a drifted claim, and model.go:307 makes NeedsHuman() true for AnchorDrifted/AnchorOrphaned independently. Mutating either alone leaves the suite green (M3, M9); only the double mutation is caught by TestDriftedClaimIsReportedNotSilentlyKept. The rule is genuinely tested, but either copy of the guard can be deleted without any test noticing.
